boss.guardiano_del_regno.intro: You carry the mark of the seed in your chest. I have waited for you longer than I remember.
boss.guardiano_del_regno.intro2: No one descends until the Dawn is ready.
boss.guardiano_del_regno.defeat: Then... the Dawn is ready. Descend, Bearer.
boss.guardiano_del_regno.lore: He guarded the castle gate for centuries, on a steed that never saw the sun. The broken crown on his helm is the last of a kingdom no one remembers.
speaker.voce.name: Dawn Voice
speaker.portatore.name: Bearer
voce.atto1.01: Can you hear me? I am here, inside you. Do not fear the dark: I am what is to come.
boss.cerbero.lore: He keeps the living out: the Gate opens only for souls. Your shadowless body weighs as much as a soul: you are the only living one who passes.
boss.cerbero.tod.notte: At night the ember eyes see farther: he opens by spitting fire.
boss.cerbero.tod.alba: At dawn the right head growls first, as if raising the alarm.
boss.pyro.lore: First of the Three Knights of the Oath, a paladin of Ouranthos who fell with Lucifer. He kept the first seal of the Cathedral and never stopped burning for the promise he made.
boss.pyro.tod.notte: At night his blade lights up the field: he opens with the waves of fire.
boss.pyro.intro: A living one without a shadow, on my embers. The fire knows you before I do.
boss.pyro.mid: I still burn for an oath no one remembers!
boss.pyro.defeat: The first seal is yours. May the Thunder find you ready.
boss.thunder.lore: Second of the Three Knights of the Oath. He swore to Ouranthos with the voice of thunder and took it back when Lucifer said no. He kept the second seal of the Cathedral: since then his storm has never stopped falling.
boss.thunder.tod.notte: At night the lightning shows before he does: he opens by marking the ground.
boss.thunder.intro: The Fire has fallen and let you through. I am not the Fire.
boss.thunder.mid: Do you hear it? The storm remembers the oath better than I do!
boss.thunder.defeat: The second seal goes dark... The Frost will not be so kind.
boss.ice.lore: Last of the Three Knights of the Oath, the youngest and the most precise. He kept the last seal of the Cathedral on the lake of Cocytus, where the cold preserves the shadows of traitors. He never missed a thrust, nor forgave a blow struck twice.
boss.ice.tod.alba: At dawn he salutes like a duelist and holds his guard longer.
boss.ice.tod.notte: At night his breath freezes before he moves: he opens with the frost breath.
boss.ice.intro: Two seals gone dark. And you, shadowless, on my ice.
boss.ice.mid: Look into my mirrors: they reflect everything, except what you lack.
boss.ice.defeat: The last seal is yours. He is waiting for you... and he has never been in a hurry.
boss.mostro_di_magma.lore: The three knights built it from the rock of the forge and from its own fire, to guard the place where the armor of the Fallen was beaten. It is the last sentinel before the Cathedral: it knows no other order than to remain.
boss.mostro_di_magma.tod.notte: At night the veins of the forge glow brighter: it opens with lava bursting from the ground.
boss.lucifero_1.intro: You are alive, little seed. What do you want from me?
boss.lucifero_1.affronta: Then come. I am in no hurry anymore.
boss.lucifero_1.implora: No one has ever begged me to live. Go.
boss.lucifero_1.shatter: I know that breath. Not here.
item.piuma_nera.name: Black Feather
item.piuma_nera.desc: A feather from Lucifer's burned wings. It weighs more than it should.
item.cicatrice_del_rifiuto.name: Scar of Refusal
item.cicatrice_del_rifiuto.desc: A mark on your chest, above the seed. Lucifer struck you only once, and let you live.
story.atto2.intro.01: The ferryman leaves you on the far bank. In the rock opens an immense arch, made of bones and iron.
story.atto2.intro.02: Beyond the arch the Twilight turns red. It is the second of the fallen worlds: the world of the Damned.
story.atto2.cerbero_intro: The chains rattle. Three heads turn toward you.
story.atto2.sigillo_fuoco: Far away, in the Fallen Cathedral, the first seal goes dark.
story.atto2.sigillo_tuono: Far away, in the Fallen Cathedral, the second seal goes dark.
story.atto2.sigillo_gelo: Far away, in the Fallen Cathedral, the last seal goes dark. The door is open.
story.atto2.magma_intro: Among the anvils of the Fallen, the rock breathes.
story.atto2.fucina_spenta: The heart goes out. For the first time in centuries, the forge is cold.
story.atto2.lucifero_trono: In the overturned nave, on a throne of swords, sits someone who is in no hurry anymore.
story.atto2.piuma_nera: A black feather comes loose from his burned wings and settles in your hands.
story.atto2.cicatrice: You wake at the foot of the Stair of the Damned. On your chest, above the seed, a mark burns: the Scar of Refusal.
voce.atto2.intro: Here fell the second world, the world of the Damned. The one who rules it was the first to say no. Listen, but do not stop.
voce.atto2.cerbero_porta: The Gate opens only for souls. You have no shadow: to it, you weigh as much as one of them.
voce.atto2.dite_altare: Souls pass without weight. You, without a shadow, are almost as light as they are.
voce.atto2.roghi_altare: Three knights swore loyalty to the one who gave you the seed. When Lucifer said no, their oath fell with him.
voce.atto2.bufera_altare: The fire has gone out. Thunder, though, does not forget: that is what makes it dangerous.
voce.atto2.cocito_altare: Shadows sleep under the ice. Do not stop to look at them: they are looking for yours, and you have none.
voce.atto2.fucine_altare: Here the armor of the Fallen was beaten, blow after blow, for centuries. The guardian of the forge never learned to stop.
voce.atto2.cattedrale_altare: Three seals gone dark. He knew you would come. He has been sitting for so long that he no longer remembers how to rise.
voce.atto2.magma_caduto: The forge goes out. Beyond it the Cathedral waits: and the one who dwells there has already heard your seed beating.
voce.atto2.scala_implora: He let you go. Not out of pity: he recognized the seed. Keep that feather.
voce.atto2.scala_affronta: He spared you. Not out of pity: he recognized the seed. That mark is not a defeat: it is a memory.
voce.atto2.scala_altare: The Stair of the Damned climbs toward the frost. Up there the sky is white, and the silence is vast.

form.prato_lunare.name: Moonlit Meadow
form.prato_lunare.desc: A night meadow of glowing flowers beneath a great moon.
form.prato_lunare.ability_desc: Unlimited Fiato for the whole duration.
form.specchio.name: Mirror
form.specchio.ability_desc: Two copies of you attack at your side with half damage, and the boss mistakes them for you.
form.gigante.name: Giant
form.gigante.ability_desc: You grow up to three times your size: heavy hits cover a huge area and break Balance faster, but you move more slowly.
form.firmamento.name: Firmament
form.firmamento.ability_desc: The boss moves at 60% speed and constellations reveal its weak points.
form.cielo_aureo.name: Golden Sky
form.cielo_aureo.desc: Golden clouds above the foliage of Yggdrasil.
form.cielo_aureo.ability_desc: You fly freely for the whole duration, with aerial attacks and golden shockwaves.
form.abisso_rosso.name: Red Abyss
form.abisso_rosso.ability_desc: Damage dealt doubles (+100% instead of +50%), but you lose 2% Health per second (never below 1 point).
form.rovescio.name: Reverse
form.rovescio.desc: An upside-down world where you can also walk on the ceiling.
form.rovescio.ability_desc: Every successful dodge sends part of the avoided attack back at the boss.
ui.title: Seventh World
story.risveglio.01: The sun no longer rises. For a time nobody remembers, the sky has stood still in a violet-and-gold twilight: beautiful, and wrong.
story.risveglio.02: Trees grow crooked toward a light that never comes. The dead find no peace. Nobody remembers the last dawn, except perhaps the oldest beasts.
story.risveglio.03: In the Castle of the Cradle, someone opens their eyes.
story.risveglio.04: You have no memories. You have no shadow. In your chest, something beats twice.
story.finale.01: The Collapse knits itself back together. Ouranthos breathes, and the Metaworld opens.
story.finale.02: A sea of clouds to the horizon. And on the horizon, the first dawn in centuries.
story.finale.03: The sun rises. For the first time, you have a shadow.
story.finale.04: The dawn is not found. It is carried.
credits.02: Conceived, written, programmed, drawn and scored entirely in code.
credits.03: Procedural world, procedural creatures, generative music, synthesized sound.
credits.04: Inspired by the great tradition of action games made of bosses, mountains and silences.
credits.05: Mythological and public-domain figures reimagined according to the game's Bible.
credits.06: Thank you for carrying the Dawn.
weapon.lama_della_culla.desc: Short sword. Quick and light with a short reach: two crossing cuts and a thrust.
weapon.lama_della_culla.flavor: A plain blade found in the empty castle. Someone left it beside your cradle, the way one leaves a lantern for someone who must set out.
art.primo_passo.name: First Step
art.primo_passo.desc: A forward lunge, quick as the first step out of the cradle.
art.ninnananna_dell_alba.name: Dawn Lullaby
art.ninnananna_dell_alba.desc: Two crossing cuts that leave a cross of pale light hanging in the air, then it bursts.
weapon.lancia_del_custode.desc: Cavalry lance. Very long-reach thrusts keep the boss at the tip; the running attack is a charge. Patient and defensive.
weapon.lancia_del_custode.flavor: White shaft, leaf-shaped head engraved with a crown. The Warden lowered it only before one who carried the Dawn.
art.carica_del_custode.name: Warden's Charge
art.carica_del_custode.desc: A forward dash that ends in a long-reach thrust.
art.ruota_d_argento.name: Silver Wheel
art.ruota_d_argento.desc: A 360-degree spin of the lance that strikes twice and pushes back nearby enemies.
weapon.brando_del_viandante.desc: Longsword. Balanced and honest: a four-step combo at medium reach. Allows the perfect parry.
weapon.brando_del_viandante.flavor: Every road the Knight rode chasing the dawn is engraved on the blade. None is missing; only the last one.
art.fendente_itinerante.name: Wayfaring Cut
art.fendente_itinerante.desc: Slide forward and rise into an upward cut.
art.postura_del_viandante.name: Wayfarer's Stance
art.postura_del_viandante.desc: Take a guard: if you are hit during the stance, you turn the blow aside and automatically counter with a powerful cut.
weapon.ramo_dell_antico.desc: Magic staff. Casts leaves that chase the target and fans of seeds; the heavy is a bursting thorn orb. Ranged magic.
weapon.ramo_dell_antico.flavor: Living wood from a seed of Yggdrasil grown without sun. Its leaves change color, searching for a light they have never seen.
art.radici_fameliche.name: Famished Roots
art.radici_fameliche.desc: Hungry roots erupt from the ground under the target and hold it for a few moments.
art.fioritura.name: Blossoming
art.fioritura.desc: The staff blooms and fires a fan of seeds in front of you.
weapon.randello_del_pantano.desc: Mace. Swinging blunt blows and an overhead smash; the heavy hits around the impact point and cracks Balance.
weapon.randello_del_pantano.flavor: Black wood and marsh reeds, with unlit lanterns hanging like trophies. If you listen, each one whispers the name of the one who carried it.
art.colpo_melmoso.name: Mud Blow
art.colpo_melmoso.desc: An area slam that splashes mud and slows everything around you.
art.sprofondamento.name: Sinking
art.sprofondamento.desc: Strike the ground and open a sucking mud pit that wounds and slows whoever stays in it.
weapon.zanna_strisciante.desc: Snake-sword. The segmented blade extends like a whip: short on the first strike, then long and wide. Best between 2 and 5 meters. Poison.
art.sibilo.name: Hiss
art.sibilo.desc: A forward dash with the blade fully extended.
art.avvolgimento.name: Coiling
art.avvolgimento.desc: The blade coils around the target, drags it toward you and holds it.
weapon.remo_del_traghettatore.desc: Halberd. Long rowing strokes that sweep wide at great reach and a chopping stroke to finish; the heavy is a double stroke.
weapon.remo_del_traghettatore.flavor: The oar that ferried more souls than there are stars. The ferryman asked for no coin: he asked for a memory.
art.richiamo_delle_anime.name: Call of the Souls
art.richiamo_delle_anime.desc: Three spectral souls rise and fly at the target one after another, chasing it.
art.spinta_della_corrente.name: Current's Push
art.spinta_della_corrente.desc: A wide rowing cut that pushes enemies back like a current.
weapon.triplice_guinzaglio.desc: Chains. Three hooked chains: every lash bites three times at medium range; the heavy whirls them all around you.
weapon.triplice_guinzaglio.flavor: The broken chains from Cerberus's neck. The Gate opens only for souls: and these chains let only you through.
art.tre_morsi.name: Three Bites
art.tre_morsi.desc: Three lashes in sequence, one per chain, like three heads biting.
art.guinzaglio.name: Leash
art.guinzaglio.desc: The hooks bite into the target and drag it toward you.
weapon.brace_eterna.desc: Greatsword. Huge, slow arcs that cover the flanks; every hit is heavy and the charged swing shatters Balance. Fire.
weapon.brace_eterna.flavor: The wavy blade of the first Knight of the Oath. Its core has never cooled: Fire swears first.
art.onda_incandescente.name: Incandescent Wave
art.onda_incandescente.desc: A cut that sends a wave of fire racing along the ground.
art.lama_rovente.name: Searing Blade
art.lama_rovente.desc: Wrap the blade in flames for 10 seconds: your hits deal more damage and burn.
weapon.tuono_spezzacielo.desc: War hammer. The slowest combo and the biggest stagger; the heavy is a thunder slam with a wide blast. Lightning.
weapon.tuono_spezzacielo.flavor: The azure head still crackles with the second Knight's discharges. Thunder swears second, and does not forget the oath.
art.schianto_tonante.name: Thundering Crash
art.schianto_tonante.desc: A vertical blow that splits the ground and releases a thunder shockwave.
art.catena_di_fulmini.name: Lightning Chain
art.catena_di_fulmini.desc: A bolt that bounces three times between targets.
weapon.brina_silente.desc: Rapier. The fastest one-handed sword: three thin thrusts and a lunge, precise but narrow. Allows the perfect parry. Ice.
weapon.brina_silente.flavor: A blade so thin its cut makes no sound. Frost swears last, and silence is its oath.
art.affondo_gelido.name: Frozen Lunge
art.affondo_gelido.desc: A forward thrust that freezes the target for an instant.
art.danza_dei_cristalli.name: Dance of Crystals
art.danza_dei_cristalli.desc: Three rapid thrusts, each loosing a shard of ice.
weapon.fenditura_ardente.desc: Two-handed axe. The heaviest single chops: narrow, brutal, slow; the heavy is a two-turn spinning cleave. Fire.
weapon.fenditura_ardente.flavor: Black rock beaten on the anvils of the Buried Forges, where the armor of the Fallen was forged. Its lava veins pulse like a heart.
art.frattura_magmatica.name: Magma Fracture
art.frattura_magmatica.desc: The blade bites the ground and tears open a lava fissure in front of you that leaves burning pools.
art.eruzione.name: Eruption
art.eruzione.desc: Leap and slam: the impact erupts in a radial explosion.
weapon.pugni_di_brace.desc: Fists. A boxer's rhythm: jabs, hooks and an uppercut, very fast and very short; the heavy is a burning ground punch. Fire.
weapon.pugni_di_brace.flavor: Gauntlets of black rock veined with fire. The Giant was not evil: he obeyed. These fists remember only duty.
art.pugno_cratere.name: Crater Punch
art.pugno_cratere.desc: A punch into the ground that sends out an expanding ring of fire.
art.presa_ardente.name: Burning Grasp
art.presa_ardente.desc: Seize the target with searing hands and hurl it away.
weapon.unghie_del_bianco.desc: Claws. Bestial and relentless: every swipe rakes more than once in a four-step combo. The fastest damage at the shortest reach. Ice.
weapon.unghie_del_bianco.flavor: Claws of bone and ice fixed on fur gloves. The Yeti did not want to fight: he was defending the only dawn the world remembers.
art.graffio_valanga.name: Avalanche Rake
art.graffio_valanga.desc: Three rapid rakes that throw up sprays of snow.
art.balzo_predatore.name: Predator's Leap
art.balzo_predatore.desc: A predator's leap that lands on the target.
weapon.baluardo_gelido.desc: Shield. Defensive by design: the guard absorbs all damage and the shield parries. Low damage, high safety; the heavy cracks Balance. Ice.
weapon.baluardo_gelido.flavor: The shield of Loki's porter, bound by an oath he no longer remembered. When he fell he said only: 'At last.'
art.urto_del_baluardo.name: Bulwark Charge
art.urto_del_baluardo.desc: A shoulder-charge behind the shield that bowls the target over.
art.muro_di_brina.name: Wall of Rime
art.muro_di_brina.desc: Raise a wall of rime in front of you that stops projectiles and wounds anyone close.
weapon.grimorio_delle_menzogne.desc: Tome. Torn pages become shards that chase the target, then a glyph circles before it bites; the heavy is a fan of five glyphs. Ranged magic.
weapon.grimorio_delle_menzogne.flavor: Green leather and golden clasps. The pages change their text every time you read them: some tell the truth, and that is their worst deceit.
art.falso_specchio.name: False Mirror
art.falso_specchio.desc: Create an illusion of yourself that draws the boss's attack; when it fades, it bursts.
art.verita_scomoda.name: Inconvenient Truth
art.verita_scomoda.desc: A beam of light that dissolves illusions and wounds whoever uses them.
weapon.zanna_d_argento.desc: Katana. Wolf-fast: drawn cut, return cut, rising cut and a crescent. Allows the perfect parry; the heavy is a lightning-quick draw.
weapon.zanna_d_argento.flavor: Silver blade, wolf-head hilt. The Great Wolf tested you to learn whether you were Chaos. Finding that you were not was his answer.
art.taglio_lunare.name: Lunar Cut
art.taglio_lunare.desc: A crescent-moon cut that flies at range and passes through targets.
art.branco.name: Pack
art.branco.desc: Three lightning-fast cuts from different angles around the target, like a pack.
weapon.asce_gemelle_del_taglialegna.desc: Twin axes. A woodcutter's rhythm: right, left, right, then both axes crossed. Short reach, steady pressure.
weapon.asce_gemelle_del_taglialegna.flav: Two axes on fir handles, moss still in the lashings. The Great Bear wanted to know whether you could protect something.
art.tempesta_di_schegge.name: Splinter Storm
art.tempesta_di_schegge.desc: A flurry of spinning chops that advances and throws up splinters.
art.abbattimento.name: Felling
art.abbattimento.desc: A crossed double chop that fells the target's Balance like a tree.
weapon.totem_degli_spiriti.desc: Totem. A wolf spirit that runs down the target, a raven that dives, then the bear face strikes up close; the heavy is a drumbeat around you.
weapon.totem_degli_spiriti.flavor: Three carved faces: wolf, bear, raven. The Shaman bound them together; now they answer the beat of your heart instead of the drum.
art.ruggito_spirituale.name: Spirit Roar
art.ruggito_spirituale.desc: The bear spirit bursts from the totem and charges forward, trampling everything in its line.
art.stormo_di_corvi.name: Flock of Ravens
art.stormo_di_corvi.desc: A wave of ravens that strikes everything in a line.
weapon.piuma_reale.desc: Longbow. Arrows fly on an arc; the heavy is a full draw that pierces and flies flatter. Ranged.
weapon.piuma_reale.flavor: Pale wood and golden feathers. The Golden Eagle mistook the ship for an invasion: it was defending a sky no one had looked at in a long time.
art.freccia_planante.name: Gliding Arrow
art.freccia_planante.desc: A long-range arrow that glides and accelerates in flight.
art.pioggia_d_oro.name: Golden Rain
art.pioggia_d_oro.desc: A volley loosed into the sky that falls back as golden rain on the target.
weapon.balestra_del_drago_ardente.desc: Crossbow. Slow, heavy, flat bolts: one shot, then a long reload you can cancel with a dodge. The heavy is an incendiary bolt that explodes; while running you strike with the stock.
art.dardo_incendiario.name: Incendiary Bolt
art.dardo_incendiario.desc: A bolt that explodes in flames on impact.
art.salva_a_scaglie.name: Scale Volley
weapon.arpione_abissale.desc: Harpoon. A mid-range hybrid: a thrust, then the harpoon thrown on its chain and reeled back (it hits going out and coming back), then a sweeping heave. Water.
art.lancio_e_richiamo.name: Cast and Recall
art.lancio_e_richiamo.desc: Throw the harpoon, hook the target and drag it toward you.
art.vortice.name: Whirlpool
art.vortice.desc: A spinning blow on the chain that draws nearby enemies into its eye.
weapon.kama_della_mantide.desc: Twin kama. A mantis rhythm: four hooked slashes alternating hands and a closing X. Short reach, the most hits per second. Nature.
weapon.kama_della_mantide.flavor: Two jade-green sickles. The Mantis King studied you with a naturalist's curiosity before striking: these blades remember every move you made.
art.imboscata_verde.name: Green Ambush
art.imboscata_verde.desc: A lightning dash through the target with a double cut.
art.falcata_incrociata.name: Crossed Sickles
art.falcata_incrociata.desc: Two cuts that cross in an X.
weapon.mandibole_imperiali.desc: Pincer blade. Two curved blades joined at the base: they snap shut on the target from both sides, sweep open, then crush. Slow, armored, punishing.
weapon.mandibole_imperiali.flavor: The mandibles of the general of Uruk's court. He recognized a worthy opponent in you, and let you pass with respect.
art.morsa.name: Vise
art.morsa.desc: The blades close on the target, crush it and hold it.
art.carica_corazzata.name: Armored Charge
art.carica_corazzata.desc: A forward shoulder-charge with the blades spread wide.
weapon.pungiglioni_regali.desc: Daggers. The fastest weapon: four stings, a twin slash and a double sting, the smallest reach and Stamina cost. The heavy is a darting lunge. Poison.
weapon.pungiglioni_regali.flavor: Two amber daggers with stinger tips. The Queen guarded the last gate, and behind it the road to the greenhouse.
art.puntura_acida.name: Acid Sting
art.puntura_acida.desc: A stab that leaves acid in the wound: damage over time.
art.sciame.name: Swarm
art.sciame.desc: A series of six lightning-fast strikes.
weapon.cesoie_del_giardiniere.desc: Shears. The two blades come apart into two short swords: right cut, left cut, thrust, then they rejoin in a snip. The heavy is a guillotine.
weapon.cesoie_del_giardiniere.flavor: The shears of a gardener who wanted something nothing could lose. 'A small garden cannot be lost.' You were the weed he could not uproot.
art.potatura.name: Pruning
art.potatura.desc: A wide scissor cut that breaks Balance.
art.innesto.name: Graft
art.innesto.desc: Plant a seed in the enemy: after three seconds it blooms into vines that bind it.
weapon.naginata_cristallina.desc: Naginata. A curved crystal blade on a long shaft: wide figure-eights that keep a broad circle clear, a full spin and a thrust. Ice.
art.falciata_glaciale.name: Glacial Reap
art.falciata_glaciale.desc: A wide cut that leaves a trail of ice on the ground that wounds and slows.
art.punta_di_cristallo.name: Crystal Point
art.punta_di_cristallo.desc: A crystal thrust that shatters Balance.
weapon.tridente_delle_tre_punte.desc: Trident. Two quick jabs with a wide tip, a raking sweep and a driving thrust. The heavy throws the trident and recalls it: it hits going out and coming back.
art.triplice_affondo.name: Triple Thrust
art.triplice_affondo.desc: Three thrusts in sequence, one per point: fire, poison and lightning.
art.lancio_del_tridente.name: Trident Throw
art.lancio_del_tridente.desc: Hurl the trident and call it back: it pierces going out and coming back.
weapon.astrolabio_ancestrale.desc: Astrolabe. Three rings orbit you and fire star bolts in turn; the third strike fires them all at once. The heavy is an orbiting star that seeks and bursts. Light.
weapon.astrolabio_ancestrale.flavor: Reina wanted to see the stars lie. In her sky the seventh place was empty: it did not say you would die, it said your sky was not yet written.
art.congiunzione.name: Conjunction
art.congiunzione.desc: The three rings align and fire a beam of light.
art.cometa.name: Comet
art.cometa.desc: Launch a comet that explodes on impact.
weapon.frusta_delle_nove_code.desc: Whip. Nine cords with brass heads: the longest reach of any melee weapon, every crack lands three times. Weak up close. Poison.
weapon.frusta_delle_nove_code.flavor: Nine cords, nine heads. The Hydra guarded the Path of Earth and asked you only whether you were ready to climb.
art.nove_morsi.name: Nine Bites
art.nove_morsi.desc: Nine lightning-fast strikes in a fan.
art.sibilo_multiplo.name: Manifold Hiss
art.sibilo_multiplo.desc: A circular lash that strikes every target around you.
weapon.ala_di_grifone.desc: Scimitar. Flowing, mobile and wide: two gliding cuts that carry you forward and a pirouette that opens space. Allows the perfect parry; the heavy is a gale cut.
weapon.ala_di_grifone.flavor: A curved, wing-shaped blade with a feathered grip. The Griffin guarded the Path of Sky: whoever defeats both keepers may climb.
art.colpo_d_ala.name: Wing Stroke
art.colpo_d_ala.desc: A wide cut like a wingbeat that throws the target back on a gust.
art.tuffo_del_rapace.name: Raptor's Dive
art.tuffo_del_rapace.desc: Leap into the air and dive onto the target with a downward slash.
weapon.spada_del_sovrano.desc: Bastard sword. Two royal one-handed cuts, a half-sword thrust, then a two-handed cut. Allows the perfect parry; the heavy is a wide sweep. Light.
weapon.spada_del_sovrano.flavor: White blade veined with gold, an azure crystal in the hilt. 'I am what remains when regret is taken away.'
art.giuramento_di_luce.name: Oath of Light
art.giuramento_di_luce.desc: A golden cut that travels at range.
art.tre_soffi.name: Three Breaths
art.tre_soffi.desc: Three successive waves: white, azure and gold.
weapon.stella_del_mattino.desc: Flail. A spiked ball on a black chain: every swing builds momentum and hits hard at the end of the chain and around the impact; the heavy whirls it three times around you. Light.
weapon.stella_del_mattino.flavor: 'I lost the sky for saying no. Prove to me that your yes is worth it.' The morning star still shines, even if no one looks at it anymore.
art.alba_spezzata.name: Broken Dawn
art.alba_spezzata.desc: Hurl the ball at long range: it bursts into rays of light.
art.caduta.name: The Fall
art.caduta.desc: Leap and slam with a red shockwave.
weapon.chakram_del_vuoto.desc: Chakram. A cutting disc: a slash with the disc in hand, then two throws that return (they cut going out and coming back). The heavy is a piercing orbital throw. Void.
art.lancio_orbitale.name: Orbital Throw
art.lancio_orbitale.desc: Throw the chakram on a wide orbit: it returns to your hand.
art.foro_nero.name: Black Hole
art.foro_nero.desc: The chakram hangs still in the air and pulls nearby enemies into its hole, then implodes.
weapon.trivella_divorante.desc: Drill-lance. It grinds: every thrust drills several times, then a sweep; the heavy is a long grinding drive that carries you forward. Strong on Balance, fair reach.
art.perforazione.name: Perforation
art.perforazione.desc: A spinning thrust that pierces guard.
art.scavo.name: Burrow
art.scavo.desc: Burrow underground and burst out beneath the target.
weapon.falce_dell_eclissi.desc: Scythe. It reaps with the blade, not the shaft: wide reaping arcs, a full spin and an overhead. The heavy reaps behind and in front. Void.
weapon.falce_dell_eclissi.flavor: Black, with a violet blade and pulsing red veins. 'I remember everything. He chose to forget so he could go on.'
art.falciata_eclissi.name: Eclipse Reap
art.falciata_eclissi.desc: An arcing cut that leaves a trail of Void that damages over time.
art.raccolto_d_ombra.name: Shadow Harvest
art.raccolto_d_ombra.desc: A spinning attack that, if it hits, gives back one Echo segment.
weapon.scettro_del_primo_respiro.desc: Scepter. Two breath bolts from the turning ring, then a short breath of light up close; the heavy is a burst of halos around you. Light.
weapon.scettro_del_primo_respiro.flavor: 'I have breathed six worlds and lost them all. The seventh I do not breathe: you do.' The seventh ring is empty no longer.
art.respiro_primordiale.name: Primordial Breath
art.respiro_primordiale.desc: A cone of primordial light breathed from the ring.
art.settimo_anello.name: Seventh Ring
art.settimo_anello.desc: Create a ring of light that pulls enemies inside and burns them.
weapon.lama_dell_abisso_sognante.desc: Shape-shifter. It changes form at every step of the combo: sword, whip, axe, spear. The heavy is an abyssal tide of tentacles. Chaos. Usable only from the Cycle of Dawn.
weapon.lama_dell_abisso_sognante.flavor: A fragment of the titan's dream. It has no shape because it dreams every shape: in your hands, for the first time, it wakes.
art.metamorfosi.name: Metamorphosis
art.metamorfosi.desc: The blade takes the chosen form (the one you stopped the combo on) and uses that form's moveset for ten seconds.
art.risveglio_abissale.name: Abyssal Awakening
art.risveglio_abissale.desc: A wave of tentacles of light erupts all around you and draws enemies in.
